Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

eyetrajectories 0.4.3 (CRAN incoming pretest correction candidate)

First-submission pretest remediation

  • Corrected ten group plotting documentation topics that incorrectly declared \arguments without function \usage. Parameter explanations remain available in descriptive \section/\describe structures.
  • Added a stricter Rd-manual preflight mirroring the Debian incoming checks.
  • Evaluating two-worker, third-edition testthat execution to lower elapsed Windows R-devel CRAN check time without dropping or skipping tests.
  • Scientific model implementations, exported function names and numerical analysis algorithms are unchanged relative to the original 0.4.2 submitted source.

Version 0.4.3 is a CRAN resubmission candidate; acceptance is not implied.

eyetrajectories 0.4.2 (release candidate; not yet published to CRAN)

Package scope and native analysis

  • Native R support for time-indexed trajectories, explicit preprocessing, kinematics, trajectory distances, dense FPCA and multivariate FPCA, recurrence and documented scientific visualization.
  • Experimental sparse PACE, functional regression, participant-level resampling, nonlinear analysis, elastic-registration and uncertainty diagnostics retain their stated data-domain and inference limitations.
  • Optional Python 1.2 interface remains separate from native R methods. A mapped Python callable does not establish a native R numerical match.

Packaging and reproducibility

  • Cross-platform R release checks passed on Windows, macOS, Ubuntu and Ubuntu oldrel-1 at development-source commit fc8f05cd061aa0cd151d4bdd5ae29356cc6fa32f.
  • Windows PDF-manual support was restored by installing an expanded TinyTeX bundle with the Courier font available.
  • An isolated R 0.4.2 release-candidate workflow is being qualified on the source tarball; candidate check results must be inspected before any CRAN submission.
  • Research-only source-contract ledgers and development files remain excluded from the CRAN source tarball by the existing build rules.

Scientific qualifications

  • The provisional 508-export source-contract ledger is not equivalent to 508 independently certified mathematical or statistical methods.
  • Experimental functional confidence bands, transfer entropy diagnostics, and uncertainty procedures require estimand-specific validation.
